title: Hawthorn garden landscape
goal: Show planting, paths, tree canopies, water feature, and dimensions.

rubric.must: Residence, lawn, perennial border, and shrub border are visibly separate labelled areas.
The reflecting pond is visibly distinct and identified by a Water feature callout.
Oak, Maple, and Birch canopies are visibly shown as separate tree symbols.
A flagstone path visibly connects the residence to the garden.
Visible 150 ft and 110 ft dimensions, north arrow, scale, and legend orient the plan.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the siteplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly shows the labeled garden areas, a distinct reflecting pond with a Water feature callout, three separate tree canopy symbols, a flagstone path connecting the residence to the garden, and the requested dimensions, north arrow, scale, and legend. No material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: Residence, Lawn, Perennial Border, and Shrub Border appear as separate, labeled areas.
A blue pond labeled Reflecting pond is distinct, with a Water feature callout pointing to it.
Separate canopy symbols appear for the Oak, Maple, and Birch, with their names shown nearby.
The labeled Flagstone path runs from the residence’s upper edge into the garden and continues toward the right side.
The plan shows 150 ft across the top and 110 ft along the left, plus a north arrow, graphic scale, and legend.
